mapper.insert: insert into article_contributor (article_id, user_id, status, apply_by, create_by, update_by) values (#{articleId}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', #{applyBy}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select contributor_id, article_id, user_id, status, advice, apply_by, apply_time, handle_by, handle_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted from article_contributor where article_id = #{articleId} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select contributor_id, article_id, user_id, status, advice, apply_by, apply_time, handle_by, handle_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted from article_contributor where contributor_id = #{contributorId}
mapper.update: update article_contributor set deleted = 1 where contributor_id = #{contributorId}
